name: dbr_vbf
question: How do depth-based and vector-based routing protocols for underwater acoustic sensor networks compare in packet delivery ratio and energy consumption?
reference: Elicit 'Draft report' run, 5 Oct 2026 (six cited papers)
expected_direction: In direct comparisons DBR uses less energy and delivers more packets than VBF (Maulana 2019: 33.6% more energy efficient, 19.8% better PDR; Hakim 2018 same direction). Caveat: VBF suits dense networks, HH-VBF was designed for sparse ones.
